reasoning: W(3,3)=27 means any 3‑coloring of the numbers 1..27 already forces a monochromatic arithmetic progression of length 3. Since the set 1..54 contains 1..27 as a subset, no 3‑coloring of 1..54 can avoid such a progression. Hence the problem is unsatisfiable.

We need a 3-coloring of 1..54 avoiding monochromatic 3-AP. Since W(3,3)=27, meaning any 3-coloring of [1..27] has a monochromatic 3-AP. For 54 >27, it's impossible? Actually van der Waerden number W(r,k) is smallest N such that any r-coloring of {1..N} contains monochromatic k-AP. So if W(3,3)=27, then any 3-coloring of 1..27 has a monochromatic 3-AP. For larger N, also any coloring will have one (since contains subset 1..27). So for 54, impossible. Thus UNSAT.

Return unsatisfiable.
